aism_behavior: class-driven (no AISM counterpart -- AISM's argument.py has no signature vocabulary, no convention profile, and no regime reasoning of any kind).
notes: Check 17(c), value half. 'inverse-polynomial' is the profile's 'inv-poly' spelled the way a human would write it -- exactly the near-miss a substring or fuzzy comparison would silently accept. The vocabulary is CLOSED: an undeclared value has no place in its key's order, so it can neither entail nor be entailed. BOTH endpoints of an interval are checked this way, not just the first.
